# Goodreads

> > Goodreads is the world's largest community for book lovers, featuring book reviews, recommendations, reading lists, and social features for discovering and tracking books.

Goodreads allows users to create custom bookshelves, share reviews, track reading progress, and connect with other readers. The platform includes community-curated collections spanning traditional published works, fanfiction from Archive of Our Own (AO3), and niche genre categories.

## Key Topics

- Archive of Our Own (AO3)
- Fanfiction
- Book shelves and lists
- Fan works
- Popular AO3 authors (SenLinYu, MsKingBean89, Onyx_and_Elm, LovesBitca8)
- Notable fanfic titles (Manacled, All the Young Dudes, Draco Malfoy and the Mortifying Ordeal of Being in Love)
- Book recommendations
- Reading communities
- User-generated book lists
- Book reviews and ratings

## Fan Works and AO3 Collections

- [Ao3 Books](https://www.goodreads.com/shelf/show/ao3): Book shelf featuring AO3 fanfiction works by SenLinYu and others
